newsitem.title: UK: UK to make statement on Paymaster Agency sell-off.
newsitem.headline: UK to make statement on Paymaster Agency sell-off.

text.p: The government will announce later on Thursday its plans for the privatisation of the Paymaster Agency, which administers some public sector pensions and acts as banking administrator for government departments and agencies, government sources said on Thursday.
The announcement will be in the form of a written answer by Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke to a parliamentary question, they said.
Written answers are generally made public after 1530 gmt each day.
The government in September invited bids for the agency, which it said would be sold with contracts in place for the provision of services for up to five years.

The agency, which has yearly turnover of more than 25 million stg, administers 1.6 million public sector pensions, operates accounts with the Bank of England of 1,400 government departments, agencies and other public-sector organizations, and has comprehensive in-house information technology systems.
